participant_id.Description: Coded participant identifier: sub-0001 through sub-0050 for the main cohort, and sub-pilot01/sub-pilot02 for the two pilot-only participants.

Description: Membership of the combined dataset: 50 main-cohort and two pilot-only participants.

age.Description: Main-cohort age at MRI acquisition, calculated as acquisition year minus birth year; birth month/day are not used. Pilot ages were not provided.

sex.Description: Main-cohort sex recorded in the study participant log. Pilot sex was not provided.

cohort.Description: Study cohort; pilot participants are distinct from the 50-participant main cohort.
